[attribute-document-type]
=== `@document-type` Related Object Document Type

Type of document being described by the <<element-related-object,`<related-object>`>> element.

#### OPTIONAL on element:  <<element-related-object,`<related-object>`>>

|===
| Value| Meaning

| Text, numbers, or special characters| The type of related object, for example,
                        “`Guide`” for a Guide to a standard.
| Restriction| This is an optional attribute; there is no default.
|===
